senses.gloss:
प्रखल प्र-खल, अस्, m. a great scoundrel,
very wicked person.

प्रखाद प्र-खाद, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. खाद्
with प्र), Ved. devouring, consuming.

प्रखिद् प्र-खिद्, cl. 6. P. -खिदति, -खेत्-
तुम्, Ved. to thrust away; to harass, afflict.

प्रख्या प्र-ख्या, cl. 2. P. -ख्याति, -ख्या-
तुम्, to see (Ved.); to announce, report; to praise,
extol, celebrate: Pass. -ख्यायते, to be recognised
or acknowledged, to be known; to shine: Caus.
-ख्यापयति, -यितुम्, to make generally known,
to be published.

प्र-ख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, visible, clear, distinct;
looking or appearing like, resembling, like (at the
end of comps., cf. शशाङ्क-किरण-प्˚); (आ), f.
look, appearance; perceptibility, visibility; making
manifest, disclosure.

प्र-ख्यस्, आस्, m. = प्रजा-पति, q. v.; the planet
Jupiter.

प्र-ख्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, celebrated, renowned,
famous, noted, notorious; recognised, acknowledged;
bespoken, forestalled, claimed by right of pre-emp-
tion; pleased, happy.
—प्रख्यात-भाण्ड, अम्, n.
a commodity the pre-emption of which is claimed
by a king.
—प्रख्यात-वप्तृक, अस्, आ, अम्,
having a celebrated father.
—प्रख्यात-सद्-भर्-
तृ, ता, m. known as a good husband.

प्र-ख्याति, इस्, f. perceptibility; publicity, no-
toriety, celebrity; praise, eulogium, fame; अ-प्र-
ख्यातिम् इ or गम्, to become imperceptible, vanish,
disappear.

प्र-ख्यान, अम्, n. perception, the being per-
ceived or being known; the making known, report-
ing, communicating; a report, information.

प्र-ख्यानीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be celebrated or
made known.

प्र-ख्यापन, अम्, n. the making known, pub-
lishing; reporting, communicating; report, inform-
ation.

प्र-ख्यापनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made gene-
rally known, to be published.

प्र-ख्यायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being celebrated,
being praised.

प्रख्याल प्र-ख्याल, probably a wrong
reading for प्र-ख्यात above.

प्राखर्य प्राखर्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-खर),
sharpness; pungency; ardour; wickedness.
